text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In my formative years, I lacked the "will"
that my peers exhibited. I
simply took
instructions and carried them out.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Everything changed when I encountered
the G1 races. For the first
time in my
existence, I felt what it was like to "yearn"
for something.

text_block_list.name: Young Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Father... I... I want to be a Triple Crown
champion.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
...You—I... I see. Their running style caught
your eye, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My father is a stoic man, but on that day I
vividly remember observing
a smile.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text: Let's do it, Bourbon. For the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That goal was one of the few choices I've
ever made that truly
reflected my "will."
My dad and I treasured it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...This concludes the memory log. I trust
that sharing this information
with you will
aid in your comprehension of me.

It's been a few days since I've become
Mihono Bourbon's trainer.
During our
downtime, she shares bits and pieces of
her past with me.

Her story continues to inspire me—a
cyborg-like girl with hopes and
dreams
hidden under her mechanical facade.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Certainly.

The corners of the trainee's lips move
upwards into a small smile.

Slowly but surely, we continue to make
progress. But as word of our
training gets
out, people begin to approach me with
remarks of
disappointment.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
What?! Mihono Bourbon's training for long
distances? That's such a
waste though! She
should just stick with sprinting!

Letting the comments fall on deaf ears, we
march on and continue
training for the
Triple Crown. The skepticism only
strengthens our
resolve to prove everyone
wrong.

Mihono Bourbon is going to show the
world what she's made of.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your recommendation is... the Tracen
Meet's 2,000-meter turf race?
The
distance is comparable to the longest
junior G1 race, the Hopeful
Stakes.

The Tracen Meet—a highly anticipated
school event with numerous
races. The
fierce competition attracts countless
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Processing new directive.

And with that, our preparations for the
meet begin.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(1,600 meters completed. 400 meters
remaining. Heart rate and
oxygen intake
are within optimal parameters.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Roger that!

Gritting her teeth, Mihono Bourbon bolts
across the track like the
wind.

The day of the Tracen Meet arrives.
Throngs of people gather, eager
to catch a
glimpse of one student—Mihono Bourbon.

Ever since the news of her switch to long
races broke out, the racer
has become a
hot topic.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I can't imagine her running 2,000
meters—she doesn't have the
stamina for
it!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
This race will be tough to watch. Honestly,
what on earth is her trainer
thinking?

Praying for Mihono Bourbon's success, I fix
my eyes on the starting
gates.
Bang!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand we're off! Who will take first place
in today's 2,000-meter
turf race?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Acquired favorable position. Preparing to
accelerate. All systems
functioning at
maximum efficiency.)

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...How the heck is Mihono Bourbon
keeping up with everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon takes the lead! Rounding
the 4th corner, she's on
fire—but wait! The
other runners are closing in fast on her as
we
approach the last stretch!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: This is it!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon has lost her lead! With
just one-hundred meters
remaining, will
she catch up in time?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(One racer ahead, two close behind.
Stamina reserves are rapidly
depleting.
Detecting lung distress. Concentration
faltering. But I...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Must win!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Four Umamusume are fighting tooth and
nail for the lead as they
approach the end!
Who will take first?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

The crowd is on the edge of their seats as
the racers charge across
the finish line.
Everyone holds their breath, waiting for
the caster to
announce the results.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The winner is—MIHONO BOURBON!
MIHONO BOURBON!

Amazed, the once-skeptical trainers now
look at her with wonder and
incredulity.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Who knew she could run 2,000 meters
like that? I'm taking my words
back about
Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we've got a new contender for
medium events now!

Today, Mihono Bourbon has made a name
for herself as a formidable
Triple Crown
challenger.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Placing first in a 2,000-meter race with
such little stamina... Well, I'll
be damned.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You really are one heck of a runner,
Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission accomplished. As per our
agreement, I have emerged
victorious in
the 2,000-meter turf race.

Mihono Bourbon joins me in the stands,
exuding her usual
calm-and-collected
demeanor despite the taxing race.

That today's results were the culmination
of grit and perseverance.

In the end, hard work surpasses
talent—there's no doubt about it. I
open
my mouth to remind her, only to find
myself choking back a sob.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've detected a shift in your emotional
state as characterized by
erratic breathing
and facial muscle contortions. However,
the cause is
unknown.

I tell her that I want her to continue to
prove that hard work surpasses
talent. Her
usually robotic eyes widen slightly in
response.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I ran only to achieve my goal. Evoking an
"emotional" response is not
currently
logged as one of my objectives.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However... given the source of the
comment, I will take it into
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have updated my objectives. They now
include the Twinkle Series,
the Classic
Triple Crown, and showing the value of
hard work.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My calculations show that there will be
challenges ahead of us, but
none too hard
to overcome with your presence.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I look forward to continue
working with you,
Fathe—Trainer.

For a moment, the racer's stoic expression
crumbles as her cheeks
redden. Although
it's just a verbal slip, I can't help but feel
that we're
getting closer.
